title: nmea0183: Add HDT sentence dissector
description:
Add sentence dissector for HDT messages.

* It uses the existing dissector for the fields.
* Report incorrect fixed text
* Report an expected but missing field


### Tested

This pcap contains valid and invalid variants of HDT sentence: [nmea-test-messages.pcapng](/uploads/a3a1b660a98105ce545c3bd0aff8f58b/nmea-test-messages.pcapng)

I have run 500 iterations of `fuzz-test.sh` with that capture.
